items.title: Dealer positive-gamma THICKENS FURTHER while front IV EASES and the pin band WIDENS with spot breaking ABOVE the prior call wall, all on a FROZEN completed-bar frontier (2026-08-04 unchanged) under a still-calm VIX band: from the prior morning 2026-08-05 read to this later-morning 2026-08-05 re-read on the SAME completed 2026-08-04 daily bar, SPY signed net GEX rises again (+3.090B → +4.574B, ~+48%, sign stays positive), the call wall lifts 775 → 780 and the put wall eases 772 → 770 (the pin band WIDENS from 3-wide to 10-wide) as spot climbs 774.22 → 776.18 and CLEARS above the old 775 call wall, yet the front expected move NARROWS and atmIV CHEAPENS (±8.92 → ±7.05, 31.13% → 24.55%) rather than richening — while the completed-bar frontier stays at 2026-08-04, the VIX band stays calm (16.5 → 16.9, score 0), breadth holds broad (62.16%) and SPY sits at the 52-week high.
items.note: Genuinely new versus the prior 'gamma-thickens-WITH-IV-richening' axis on a frozen frontier: that axis paired MORE positive gamma with RICHENING front vol and a COMPRESSING pin band; THIS axis is the mirror image — gamma thickens further AND front vol EASES AND the pin band WIDENS AND spot breaks up through the prior call wall, together on the same still-frozen 2026-08-04 frontier. It is also distinct from a plain gamma-thickening axis (which says nothing about front vol) and from a plain frontier-advance persistence axis (no new completed bar exists here). Emit only when the completed-bar frontier is UNCHANGED (no advance) AND signed net GEX rises materially with the sign held positive AND the pin band WIDENS (call wall up, put wall flat-or-down) with spot breaking above the prior call wall AND atmIV / front expected move EASE — so a re-read that richens front vol, compresses the band, or advances the frontier does not trip this flag.
items.method: Add a 'gamma-thickens-with-IV-easing-and-band-widening-on-frozen-frontier' composite test that compares the prior-window options/gamma read to the current read while asserting the completed-bar frontier is UNCHANGED (dataFreshness.bars.expectedSessionDate holds 2026-08-04 with freshSymbolCount==symbolCount==291, carriedSymbolCount==0, missingSymbolCount==0, and the swing bar count static at 508). Assert FIVE joint conditions: (1) FROZEN FRONTIER — expectedSessionDate unchanged versus the prior window and swing bars static (508 → 508); (2) GAMMA THICKENS — signedNetGEX rises materially (3.090B → 4.574B, ~+48%) with the sign staying positive; (3) PIN BAND WIDENS AND SPOT BREAKS UP — the call wall lifts (775 → 780) while the put wall is flat-or-down (772 → 770) so the band widens 3-wide → 10-wide, and spot rises (774.22 → 776.18) to CLEAR above the prior call wall (775); (4) FRONT VOL EASES — atmIV falls (31.13% → 24.55%) and the front expected move narrows (±8.92 → ±7.05); (5) CALM-IMPLIED / STABLE-CONTEXT GUARD — the VIX band stays calm (16.5 → 16.9, score 0), breadth holds broad (62.16%, threshold 60) and SPY is at the 52-week high (pctFrom52wHigh 0, bull-stack). Emit only when (1) AND (2) AND (3) AND (4) AND (5) all hold; the divergence is (2)+(3) thickening/upward-widening gamma occurring together with (4) EASING front vol — the reverse of the prior richening-IV pairing.
